description: Search for bills in Congress. Provide `query` for full-text keyword/topic search (e.g. "broadband", "veterans healthcare") via GovInfo's full-text bill index; results include a congress-type-number id you can pass to get_bill_details. Without `query`, returns the most recently updated bills (optionally filtered by type).

congress.description: Congress number (defaults to the current Congress)

query.description: Keyword or topic to full-text search bill text (e.g. "broadband"). Omit to list most recent bills.

name: search_legislation
title: Bill search
